title: Transmission, Spread, Longevity and Management of Hop Latent Viroid, a Widespread and Destructive Pathogen Affecting Cannabis (Cannabis sativa L.) Plants in North America
notes: Cannabis-specific evidence on HLVd distribution, propagation/stock infection, root-associated spread and persistence. Specific disinfection treatments reported in the study must not be converted into an operational chemical recipe without exact product concentration, materials compatibility, worker safety, label/legal review and facility validation.
